name: Single-stage progression
purpose: One persistent stage; each step moves the focus to one or more of your items (the rest dim), swaps a caption in place and advances a tracker.

implementation.api: Studio.comp.progression(parent, {items, steps}, {dim, scale, tracker}) -> {enter, to(tl, step, at, {duration 0.45}), exit}; call to() in time order

layout_notes: The caption and tracker are built in `parent`; the items stay where you laid them out (their transform is set to a scale).

validation.evidence: Runtime checks tests/studio-runtime/explain-devices.html (63 checks incl. seek-order independence) in Playwright Chromium on Windows, 2026-11-28; golden scene tests/reference-derived/explain-tour-progression/index.html frame review 0 errors 0 warnings and contact sheet inspected. Not rendered through HyperFrames on the M2, so not approved.
